name: @inneranimalmedia/primetech-procedures
purpose: Versioned PrimeTech workflow manifests, schema validation, authorized SAM operation orchestration, native asset inventory, run receipts, output hashes, and performance evidence without creating a second runtime or database registry.
use_when: Turning a successful multi-step engineering or repository task into a versioned, repeatable procedure
Composing existing SAM operations with pinned Bash, Python, and native-tool steps
Capturing procedure, entrypoint, input, output and artifact hashes with verification receipts
avoid_when: Creating a replacement SAM kernel, terminal daemon, scheduler, or global registry
Running untrusted or caller-supplied shell commands
Executing physical machinery without a separately approved safety-governed system
